items.title: Tigers must win big against Afghanistan and overcome NRR mountain to reach tri-series final

items.title: Can Tigers’ middle order bat smarter?
items.summary: Bangladesh failed to build on a decent start against Zimbabwe, struggling to rotate strike as pressure mounted. Hridoy tried to force the pace and fell, triggering a collapse that saw the Tigers bowled out for 172 in 33.4 overs while chasing 272.
